text: everything fits in 360mb like 360 would be the ceiling?
resolution: Clarification of the 360 MiB figure from req_2841: YES it is the hard ceiling for world STRUCTURE today — the geometry (256 MiB), placement (32 MiB), foliage (24 MiB) and staging pools are fixed at creation and cannot grow; overflow degrades loudly (retained → per-frame staging → dropped groups), never crashes. NO it is not total app VRAM — textures (material tiles, paint atlases, model atlases), swapchain and depth are allocated on demand on top and grow with content. Net: built meshes/placements can never exceed ~360 MiB on any hardware until the elastic-pools + real-device-limits ruling (req_2839) is made. Answer only, no code changed.
